work.name: HolyPoly
work.summary: Responsible for all aspects of corporate  IT: strategy, infrastructure, services, software development, operations and security.
highlights: Build-up and leading a 5-member IT team, managed freelancers on various projects.
Introduced agile development and operations methodologies. Established automated CI/CD pipelines with trunk-based development, reducing cycle time by a factor of 2.

Designed and implemented software architecture for reverse logistics programs focused on recycling plastic toys for multinational toy and baby product companies, integrating with the corporate website via a REST API.

Developed a Bluetooth-WebSocket bridge service for a handheld X-ray fluorescence device accelerating the detection of inorganic impurities in recyclable plastic toys and power tool housings. Empowering corporate clients to make data-driven decisions on recycled plastic usage in new products based on millions of data points.

Introduction of open-source ERPNext as Open Source ERP software, adapting it for cloud-native patterns to enable quick deployment of instances, streamlining business processes and reducing application and data fragmentation.
Responsible for the establishing an ISMS to meet corporate and customer IT security and data protection compliance requirements.

work.name: Startnext
work.summary: Operations of the crowdfunding platform infrastructure.
highlights: Migrated storage from NFS to Ceph distributed storage enabling concurrent read and write access.
Transformed the legacy PHP crowdfunding application to run on a container-based infrastructue enabling horizontal scaling with seamless platform code roll-outs.
Automated platform code deployment via CI/CD pipelines improving software QA, developer experience and time spent by developers for crowdfunding platform updates

Redesigned monitoring, alerting, and logging stack using Telegraf, Loki, InfluxDB, Alertmanager, and Grafana. Leading to reduced operational costs and improved monitoring efficacy while also providing improved business intelligence capabilities.
